title: Find the words
caption: The night before her test, Hana searches the Wall for exam. The founder tells her story.
linkedin_text: Pills on Waypoint's Wall switch between New and Top today, this week and this month. A magnifier searches post text from two letters, and a dice button shows one random post.

cast.hana: Hana, a young woman with a high ponytail in a navy hoodie, studying at a desk with a lamp

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a black-and-white floral shirt and khaki shorts, facing the camera on a quiet campus path in the evening, a relaxed smile.
scenes.vo: Hi. This is Hana's story. It is the night before her test, and her head is loud.
scenes.sub: Hi. This is Hana's story. It is the night before her test, and her head is loud.
scenes.title: Find the words

scenes.clip: {hana} at a desk with open notebooks late at night, rubbing her eyes, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: She wonders if anyone else feels like this.
scenes.sub: She wonders if anyone else feels like this.

scenes.clip: {hana} opening her phone with a hopeful look, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: On Waypoint's Wall, pills switch between New, and Top today, this week and this month.

scenes.clip: {hana} typing on her phone with focus, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.

scenes.clip: {hana} tapping her phone with a small smile, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.

scenes.clip: {hana} closing her notebook with a relieved smile, lamp glowing behind her.
scenes.vo: She finds she is not the only one, and she sleeps.
